# L3 — Processual

**MEF lens `L3`** · Square C — Becoming `[2 + 3]`: logic ⇄ process, synchronic ⇄ diachronic · Day face · index `#3` · tonic `F♯` · ground-pair **Logos/Decision** (Name-led) · twin: [L3′ — Chronological](L3-prime-chronological.md)

*Root:* Whitehead, Bergson, Lacan · *Key concept:* concrescence · *Element:* Water · *Möbius:* `L3 → L2′`

Grounds on proportionate gathering (Logos) over the cutting commitment (Decision): becoming as *concrescence that decides itself* — each occasion gathers by excluding. Anchor index 3.

## Sublens

The six inner sublenses, each tagged with its rotated `Name[note]` / `Power[note]` (chromatic-basis note-tags):

- **L3.0 — Concrescent desire** (`Logos[F♯]` / `Decision[G]`) — pure appetition toward determination; Lacan's *manque-à-être*.

- **L3.1 — Actual occasion** (`Son[G♯]` / `Love[A]`) — the "drop of experience" receiving its initial data through physical prehension.

- **L3.2 — Ingression** (`Image[A♯]` / `Work[B]`) — how eternal objects enter the becoming occasion; the entry of novelty into time.

- **L3.3 — Eternal objects** (`Truth[C]` / `Play[C♯]`) — the "forms of definiteness," the repertoire of possible patterning.

- **L3.4 — Community integration** (`Mind[D]` / `Need[D♯]`) — how occasions form societies through mutual prehension; the relational dimension.

- **L3.5 — Satisfaction/Perishing** (`Word[E]` / `Sacrifice[F]`) — full determinacy achieved; the occasion perishes as subject, becomes objectively immortal datum.


## Derivation at this index

*8-fold:* sounds Son·Image·Truth·Mind + Love·Work·Play·Need; anchors Logos, Word, Decision, Sacrifice. *Diatonic:* Logos–Son–Image · Work–Play–Need–Sacrifice.

*Reading:* grounded on Logos/Decision, the whole field reads as creative advance — gathering that commits, the many becoming one and increased by one.
